full_rows.english: Just because we said that about the other case doesn't mean that it's true in every case. Therefore what happened was that, at first, he saw some water. Later on, he was forced by his karma to stop seeing water and saw only bare, parched earth. Then he had an impression where he thought the water had dried up. The case with the fruit tree is the same. Although at first the craving spirit sees a tree loaded with fruit, later on his karma forces him to stop seeing fruit, and all he sees is bare branches. Then he has an impression where he thinks that the tree has no fruit any more.

full_rows.english: Suppose though then a master woodsman arrived; one who understood the crucial point of the tree.  He would figure out the channel in the tree through which it took its water. full_rows.english: If on top of this you wish to draw into you the element of enlightenment from your Woman of Wisdom, then first see a red huung syllable at the tip of your secret diamond.  See a hook of light, hot as if it had been laid in a fire, touching the element within the lotus of the Woman.  Imagine that it dissolves the element and absorbs it, like spit on a hot iron griddle.  A meditator should feel bliss even just doing this.
